name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-search
title: Web Search + Page Reader, pay per call (x402)
description: Live web search and a page reader (HTML or PDF to markdown) for coding agents. No API key: x402.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Ranked live web results (title, url, snippet, source, date when known) for a query, as JSON. Filter by age (published_within) or by site (include_domains / exclude_domains). A query with no results is not charged. $0.00435 USDC per call via x402.

published_within.description: Only pages from the last N days, or day|week|month|year

include_domains.description: Comma list of sites to keep, e.g. github.com,docs.python.org

exclude_domains.description: Comma list of sites to drop

x_payment.description: x402 payment: base64 PaymentPayload for the invoice returned by an unpaid call (same value as the X-PAYMENT / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

free_trial.description: Use the free daily trial when no payment is given (3 calls a day per IP). false = return the x402 invoice straight away.

tools.name: read_page
